future_use_rule: Every later liver disease must use this configuration and the hashed source model without architecture, registration, anchor, calibration, operator, guard, fallback, or metric changes.

sealed_until_prediction_lock: target disease labels and severity for fitting
target anatomical or pathology annotations for fitting

expression_processing.source_normalization: counts scaled per spot to the median healthy-source depth, followed by log1p
expression_processing.target_depth: source-trained ridge depth model using only the 16 target-anchor counts
expression_processing.target_transform: anchor counts scaled to source median depth using predicted target depth, followed by log1p
expression_processing.negative_prediction_handling: clip final MAP log1p predictions at zero

original_selection_rule.information: healthy source only, restricted to assay-known shared genes
original_selection_rule.eligibility: source prevalence between 0.05 and 0.98, variance greater than 1e-5, excluding MT-, RPL, and RPS prefixes

anchor_panel.future_missing_anchor_rule: A later target lacking any frozen anchor is not eligible for the exact frozen protocol; do not substitute a gene or rerun panel selection under this protocol.

geometry_registration.coordinate_canonicalization: subtract coordinate-wise median and divide by the 0.99 quantile of radial distance
geometry_registration.target_support_rule: nearest registered-source distance no greater than 2.0 times median target nearest-neighbor spacing

registered_atlas_prior.residual_pearson: undefined; never encode or plot as zero

hyperspatial_map.raw_residual_features: 16 target-anchor residuals relative to registered IDW
candidate_operators: anchor-only decoded expression as an internal fusion candidate

source_only_operator_selection_and_guard.selection_rule: among candidates within 1.05 times the minimum source-validation MSE, select the highest source-validation spatial Pearson
source_only_operator_selection_and_guard.guard_rule: apply the source-selected correction only when selected MSE is lower than IDW MSE and selected Pearson exceeds IDW Pearson by more than 0.03

evaluation.no_pseudoreplication: spots, genes, biopsies, and sections are not independent biological replicates
evaluation.post_lock_spot_qc: nFeature greater than 10 and mitochondrial percentage less than 10
evaluation.post_lock_hidden_gene_qc: nonzero in more than 3 spots per target array
metrics: log1p RMSE pooled across target units and hidden genes
fraction hidden genes with MAP spatial Pearson greater than IDW
fraction hidden genes with MAP RMSE less than IDW
fraction hidden genes with positive MAP residual Pearson

residual_definition.measured: target truth minus registered IDW atlas prior
residual_definition.predicted: MAP prediction minus registered IDW atlas prior

freeze_prohibitions: no comparator other than registered 12-NN IDW in manuscript-facing liver benchmarks
